metadata.title: Newton PR 3187 Isaac Lab Startup Benchmark

cpu_limit.method: taskset affinity inherited by benchmark subprocesses
cpu_limit.effective_cpu_fraction: 50% of the 4-CPU quota visible to nproc

notes: All reported Isaac Lab samples were rerun at 1024 environments under a 2-logical-CPU affinity cap: taskset -c 0,1.
Single raw sample per task/revision; no repeat medians.
The benchmark command used uv run --no-sync so Isaac Lab retained the editable Newton worktree install for each revision.
Ant, Humanoid, G1, and Franka runs include LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/nvidia/cu13/lib so PyTorch/Triton can find libnvrtc-builtins.so.13.0.
Franka uses Isaac-Reach-Franka because Isaac-Lift-Cube-Franka does not expose the newton_mjwarp preset in this Isaac Lab checkout.
Task IDs are the names registered by this Isaac Lab checkout; some keep their -v0 suffix and some do not.
